audit.why: Nami holds Levels 1-5 and 1st item on open-lane poke; Level 6 is genuinely skill-based (both ults are fight-deciding and whoever times R first wins it); Nami keeps 2+ items on team-wide peel — matches whys[] already.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Cosmic Binding as the tracked cooldown but never gives a number.
audit.why: Cosmic Binding (Q) is 11/10/9/8/7s; Caretaker's Shrine (W) has 0 cooldown, so his heal-shrine is always available and only anti-heal (not cooldown pressure) denies it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two missing-interaction flags: Tempered Fate (R) can stasis a target out of a committed burst combo, and Caretaker's Shrine (W) sustain isn't named as an anti-heal target.
audit.why: Tempered Fate freezes everything hit (including allies) for its duration — dumping a full combo the instant he casts wastes it into stasis. Caretaker's Shrine heals and speeds the first ally to touch it, so Grievous Wounds timing matters in extended trades.
audit.corrected: report[9] (All-In Windows) now warns about stasis timing; report[8] (Itemization) names Caretaker's Shrine as the anti-heal target.
